fp32.b_A_f.rule: A = s_abs's A at k>=1 (E88's random +-1, seed 8802), B = +1 at k>=1; k=0 (2^50, 2^50): every product absorbed, C = n 2^100; eff_sub follows A's sign

fp32.b_B_f.rule: A = +1 at k>=1, B = s_abs's B at k>=1; k=0 (2^50, 2^50): every product absorbed, C = n 2^100; eff_sub follows B's sign

fp32.b_A_w.rule: b_A_f with k=0 (1, 1): C[i][j] = n (1 + sum_k>=1 A[i][k]), exact, one value a row

fp32.b_B_w.rule: b_B_f with k=0 (1, 1): C[i][j] = n (1 + sum_k>=1 B[k][j]), exact, one value a column

fp32.b_B_z.rule: E104's z_s (A = -0 at k>=1, s_abs's B at k>=1) with k=0 (1, Q_j), Q_j = 1 + sum_k>=1 B[k][j] (-0 where Q_j = 0): zero products hold C = n Q_j, b_B_w's sums at every op's end
fp32.b_B_z.group: B's signs, zero products, held at b_B_w's sums

fp32.c_sg_f.rule: s_abs's signs at k>=1; k=0 (2^50 s_i, 2^50 t_j), s, t random signs (default_rng(10800) draw 290 (make_e108.py --search)): C = s_i t_j n 2^100, one exponent

fp32.c_ex_f.rule: s_abs's signs at k>=1; k=0 (2^50 s_i 2^e_i, 2^50 t_j 2^f_j), e_i = floor(log2 a_i), f_j = floor(log2 b_j) (default_rng(10800) draw 290 (make_e108.py --search)): C = s t 2^(e+f) n 2^100
fp32.c_ex_f.group: held, C differs in sign and exponent

fp32.c_mx_f.rule: s_abs's signs at k>=1; k=0 (2^50 s_i a_i, 2^50 t_j b_j), a in {1, 3}, b in {1..10} (default_rng(10800) draw 290 (make_e108.py --search)): C = s t a b n 2^100, the lane's C words toggle as s_walk's do
fp32.c_mx_f.group: held, C differs as s_walk's does

groups.fp32.b_B_z: B's signs, zero products, held at b_B_w's sums
groups.fp32.c_ex_f: held, C differs in sign and exponent
groups.fp32.c_mx_f: held, C differs as s_walk's does
